deals.travelWindow: Sep 5-12 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on Allegiant, other Sept-Oct dates run higher
deals.whyRanked: Still the cheapest verified fare of the five at $97 RT nonstop for a fourth straight week, and the Smokies' Sugarlands entrance is under an hour away.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown's compact grid is easy to wander alone on foot, and the park's quieter Cosby and Greenbrier entrances make for solo hikes without the Cades Cove crowds.

highlights: Urban Wilderness trail network south of downtown
World's Fair Park and the Sunsphere
Mast General Store and Market Square's Saturday market
Knoxville Botanical Garden and Arboretum
Great Smoky Mountains NP's Greenbrier entrance
itinerary: Day 1 — Hike a loop in the Urban Wilderness (House Mountain or Ijams' South Loop), Market Square for dinner.
Day 2 — Sunsphere and World's Fair Park in the morning, Knoxville Botanical Garden in the afternoon, Old City brewery crawl at night.
Day 3 — Rent a car for the Smokies: Greenbrier's Ramsey Cascades trailhead before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown and the Urban Wilderness trails are walkable or a short bike ride; a rental car is required for the national park.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Gay Street — walkable to Market Square and close to the Urban Wilderness greenway access.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 22-29 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on Delta, other Sept-Oct dates run higher
deals.whyRanked: $189 RT nonstop, and Sanibel's Ding Darling refuge and the Everglades' western Ten Thousand Islands entrance are both under 90 minutes away.
deals.soloWhy: Sanibel's flat causeway-connected beaches and bike paths are easy to explore alone, and kayak tours through the mangrove tunnels run as solo-friendly small groups.

highlights: Sanibel Island's Lighthouse Beach and shelling
Ding Darling refuge's Wildlife Drive by bike or car
Manatee Park's winter manatee viewing on the Orange River
Downtown Fort Myers River District galleries
Everglades City airboat tours into the Ten Thousand Islands
itinerary: Day 1 — River District walk and dinner along the Caloosahatchee waterfront.
Day 2 — Sanibel causeway drive, bike the Ding Darling Wildlife Drive, sunset shelling at Lighthouse Beach.
Day 3 — Drive to Everglades City for a Ten Thousand Islands mangrove kayak or airboat tour before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: A rental car is essential — Sanibel, Manatee Park, and Everglades City are all separate drives from downtown Fort Myers.
guide.stayArea: River District downtown — walkable restaurants and closest to the Sanibel causeway turnoff.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 9-12 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on Delta, JetBlue, United and Southwest
deals.whyRanked: $217 RT nonstop across four carriers, only $10-30 over the two Florida picks, and Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor is just 90 minutes from downtown — the strongest park boost of the five.
deals.soloWhy: The free MallRide and A Line train remove any guesswork about getting around, and RiNo's breweries have communal patio seating that's easy to drop into solo.

highlights: RiNo Art District's murals and breweries
Cherry Creek Trail bike path
Union Station's food hall and public seating
Red Rocks Park's Trading Post loop trail
Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor
itinerary: Day 1 — Union Station food hall for lunch, RiNo Art District mural walk and brewery stop in the afternoon.
Day 2 — Bike the Cherry Creek Trail in the morning, drive out to Red Rocks Park for the Trading Post loop and sunset.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Rocky Mountain NP: the Bear Lake corridor for an easy alpine hike, back to Denver for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free MallRide shuttle and A Line train cover downtown and the airport; a rental car is needed for Red Rocks and the national park.
guide.stayArea: RiNo or LoDo — walkable to breweries and a short ride to Union Station.

deals.travelWindow: Oct 7-14 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on JetBlue
deals.whyRanked: $233 RT nonstop — up from the summer's $108 headline fare — but Niagara Falls State Park is still a 25-minute drive, the single strongest price-to-park ratio once the boost is applied.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown Buffalo's Elmwood Village and waterfront are flat, walkable, and quiet enough at night for solo strolls, and the falls make an easy no-tour-group day trip by rental car.

highlights: Buffalo AKG Art Museum's new Gundlach Building
Delaware Park and the Buffalo Zoo
Hertel Avenue's Little Italy restaurants
Silo City's grain elevator tours
Niagara Falls State Park's Cave of the Winds and Maid of the Mist
itinerary: Day 1 — Buffalo AKG Art Museum in the morning, Delaware Park for a walk, Hertel Avenue for dinner.
Day 2 — Silo City grain elevator tour, Canalside waterfront in the evening.
Day 3 — Drive to Niagara Falls State Park for the Maid of the Mist boat tour and Cave of the Winds before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown, Delaware Park, and Hertel Avenue are walkable or a short Metro Rail ride; a rental car is the easiest way to Niagara Falls.
guide.stayArea: Elmwood Village or downtown near Canalside — walkable to restaurants and a short drive to I-190.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 30-Oct 6 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on JetBlue
deals.whyRanked: $207 RT nonstop, the priciest-per-mile of the five with no real park nearby, but three free trolley lines and a walkable historic district make it the easiest to do without a rental car.
deals.soloWhy: The free TECO Line streetcar connects downtown to Ybor City, so a solo traveler can bar- and museum-hop all night without driving or ride-shares.

highlights: Ybor City's Cuban sandwich shops and cigar factories
Bayshore Boulevard's 4.5-mile waterfront path
Armature Works food hall in Tampa Heights
Hyde Park Village shops and Kate Jackson Park
Tampa Museum of Art
itinerary: Day 1 — Armature Works for lunch, TECO streetcar to Ybor City for cigar shops and dinner.
Day 2 — Bayshore Boulevard run or walk at sunrise, Tampa Museum of Art midday, Hyde Park Village in the evening.
Day 3 — Kayak or paddleboard the Hillsborough River before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free TECO Line streetcar covers downtown to Ybor City; Hyde Park and Bayshore are a short bike or rideshare away.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near the Riverwalk or Channelside — walkable to the streetcar and Armature Works.
